effect_prompt: The camera slowly pushes in toward the product in a smooth, continuous zoom, gradually filling more of the frame with it over time. The golden balloons break free and rise quickly on their own, their short strings no longer reaching down to the product, drifting up and out of frame through the top edge as the camera moves closer. The cardboard box flaps at the bottom of the frame drift out of view as the camera approaches. Golden confetti pieces keep falling steadily and thickly throughout, drifting past the product and scattering on the floor, catching glints of light as they tumble. Bright clean studio lighting, photorealistic advertisement cinematography.
